profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ LinkedIn
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
With extensive experience in software engineering, I specialize in frontend development and technical mentorship, currently contributing to LinkedIn as a Senior Software Engineer. I am committed to building scalable, user-focused solutions and fostering collaboration across teams to support LinkedIn’s mission of connecting professionals globally. By leveraging my expertise in React.js, Node.js, and deep learning, I aim to enhance user engagement and optimize platform performance.  

At LinkedIn, I’ve led frontend projects in the Campaign Manager team, delivering innovative products through collaboration with developers, UX designers, and product managers. I have developed and reviewed technical documentation to align on robust engineering solutions and supported team growth by mentoring colleagues on best practices. My approach focuses on delivering impactful, resilient applications that meet the needs of users and stakeholders alike.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered AI-assisted ad-creation workflows in Campaign Manager using Ember.js, JavaScript, and generative AI APIs, integrating copy suggestions and reliable polling for image generation and CDN availability. Centralized multi-ad save orchestration to support reuse beyond the original campaign-review interface.
• Developed full-stack Creator Marketplace and BrandLink discovery and sponsorship features using React, TypeScript, Java, and gRPC. Extended Python, Scala, Spark, and Airflow workflows for creator-feature engineering, embedding enrichment, Pinot publishing, vector indexing, and automated relevance evaluation.
• Expanded multi-asset ad creation using Ember.js, Glimmer, and asynchronous APIs, allowing advertisers to generate separate image or video creatives from one asset-selection workflow while retaining upload validation and accessible alt-text support.
• Built media-asset diagnostic interfaces using React, TypeScript, Material UI, and Storybook, giving engineers integrated views of metadata, processing anomalies, and image, document, and video artifacts for asset inspection and debugging.
• Designed a unified domain model across products owned by multiple teams, eliminating redundant implementations and accelerating releases. Authored and reviewed RFCs to align cross-functional stakeholders.
• Introduced designers and product managers to programming with Claude and mentored junior engineers in engineering best practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
positions.description:
• Served as the lead developer for the 2020 Election Center team of 5 developers.
• Developed interactive maps for the 2020 and 2018 election centers. (https://www.cnn.com/election/2020/results/president)
• Developed a resilient full-stack application with React, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, and Lambdas that served 400,000 concurrent users on the 2020 presidential election day.
• Developed components that served live 2018 midterm election results on the CNN.com frontpage.
• Maintained all the previous election centers from 2016, 2017, and 2018 for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
• Built Jenkins pipeline to generate daily reports for performance degradation and accessibility compliance score of the frontend application.
• Prototyped a multiplayer 3D interactive experience with Babylon.js and Websocket with custom netcode.
• Worked closely with cross-functional teams including CNN’s Editorial, Product, QA, and Design.
• Held tech talks with fellow developers to share ideas and technical knowledge.

positions.title: Frontend Developer (Angular 1/Angular 2+)
positions.description:
• Served as a member of the Architecture team
• Managed and developed the internal frontend component library which was published to NPM.
• Researched and initiated the migration of the frontend application from Angular 1 to Angular 4 using Webpack.
• Introduced Redux to a monolithic Angular 1 application to reduce the number of varying design patterns across multiple frontend teams.
• Held lunch and learn sessions to spread general frontend knowledge.
• Worked with UI architects to improve the frontend application's performance and fix design flaws.
• Developed frontend feature deliverables that were planned for each sprint.
• Maintained the frontend app's NPM package versions and breaking changes.
• Introduced Angular 4 Jasmine testing to the frontend engineering team.
• Wrote documentation on best practices and how-to guides for the frontend technologies in use.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer (Ember.js/Ruby on Rails)
positions.description:
• Developed the UI of the web application from ground up using Ember.js JavaScript framework.
• Expanded a Ruby on Rails application with additional API endpoints to serialize both NoSQL and MySQL data into JSON-API specification for front-end consumption.
• Implemented caching for high frequency data and queuing Active Jobs for data analysis.
• Performed MySQL database migrations.
• Created a suite of interactive chart elements with D3.js.
• Incorporated interactive maps with Leaflet.js and advanced charts with Highcharts.js.
• Improved the front-end performance and ensured a smooth experience on mobile devices.
• Maintained breaking changes of new NPM JavaScript package releases.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: • Created a JavaScript application to automate and reduce the time spent on a design approval process by 80%.
